implementation_obligations.admission: Keep seven existing calls. Add closed optional open-session request runtime=stub|sbcl, default stub; persist selection in controller metadata and reject mismatched reopen. No arbitrary runtime_command or caller executable. Resolve actual SBCL on explicit sbcl selection; absent/failed startup is nonzero, never fallback. Start fixed repository Lisp loop without user/system init, using SBCL built-ins and Python standard library only.
implementation_obligations.payload: Existing payload.expression remains a nonempty string: stub retains its JSON set/get/gate grammar; SBCL accepts Lisp source forms under the requested existing kind. Defer runtime-specific parsing until selection is known; source-bound handoff templates validate under the selected runtime. No lifecycle evaluation, shell interpretation or admission bypass. Establish package/readtable/printer and correlated operation bindings inside each worker thread.
implementation_obligations.transport: Adapt existing private bounded transport as needed for built-in-only SBCL, with separate diagnostic output. Preserve strict frame limits/types, owner/generation/lease/attempt guards, duplicate-ID precedence, atomic records and one busy lane. Accept results only from the current correlated operation/runtime; malformed, stale or unsolicited frames cannot manufacture completion or free busy state.
implementation_obligations.capture: Use handler-bind to capture condition identity, actual active backtrace and compute-restarts while original dynamic context exists, before unwind; handler-case after unwind is insufficient. Serialize bounded restart descriptions, never durable invocable objects or automatic restart invocation. Store diagnostics by condition_ref with condition_capture=before_unwind; honest failed/partial load_source or compile_source yields condition_signalled and image_consistent=false, preserving earlier effects without rollback claims. Quarantine an inconsistent image from further project execution pending explicit reconstruction.
implementation_obligations.printing: Bound diagnostic depth, length, total bytes and wall time with finite documented defaults and stricter requested limits. Bind print-level/length/circle; arbitrary condition-report/print-object callbacks cannot evade budgets. Use trusted minimal type/identity fallback, explicit truncation/capture-failure markers and no recursive unsafe reporting. A stuck capture remains outstanding execution; only confirmed stop or observed process termination resolves it.
implementation_obligations.wait: Timed polling/disconnect stops waiting only: stopped_waiting preserves running/cancel_requested/unknown and busy lane. Concurrent project work remains refused until outcome is resolved. Reattach preserves actual live generation, owner/lease, outstanding operation and governed attempt.
implementation_obligations.cancel: Publish cancel_requested/cancellation_confirmed=false before sending one correlated request. Confirm cancelled only after operation unwind/cleanup has actually finished and runtime reports matching session/operation/generation/lease. Evaluate residual consistency independently; do not require image_consistent=true to accept a truthful cancellation. Preserve completion-winning races and idempotence. Missing/wrong/forged acknowledgements or child death cannot count as cancellation.
implementation_obligations.termination: Use a finite documented cancellation-confirmation deadline; on inability to confirm, terminate the proven owned runtime process group with bounded escalation, observe death before terminated, record image_consistent=false and end that generation. Never kill a broad process name/unowned group. Until death is established retain unknown/busy uncertainty. Old-generation submits/reattach cannot execute, auto-restart or clear uncertainty; explicit reconstruction creates a new counter/nonce while preserving contract/step/attempt. Keep supervisor/control lifetime distinct from runtime group lifetime.
